risks: Native PersonalTask timestamps do not encode precision or IANA zone. Storing date-only only in Calendar UI would silently lose it on owner reload; prerequisite-owner precision support is mandatory.

Host-local Date and fixed MS_DAY arithmetic in existing helpers are not a timezone/DST implementation. Reusing parseNlDate as a lossless DateValue converter would fabricate 09:00 times and shift calendar days.
Calendar event visibility/connected account/scoped calendar IDs are not write authorization. Subscriptions must remain read-only with no local fake save or provider write.

Remote event id alone collides across accounts/calendars; native Task and Event must remain different refs even when titles/dates match. Use the accepted authoritative ref mapping and existing account-scoped helper without flattening identifiers.

Provider queued versus externally acknowledged state, etag conflicts, unknown external outcomes and out-of-order ACKs require native journal/fence evidence. A local receipt/toast or fixture adapter is not live-provider success.

Recurring events need explicit supported occurrence/series scope from the provider owner; do not accidentally move a whole series or erase exceptions. Missing support must remain an honest typed diagnostic.

Only NotesViewHost is a normative shared patch path. Backend registration, upstream route selectors, native type changes and locale catalogs cannot be opportunistically edited by the 021 worker; accepted upstream interfaces or reviewed packet changes are needed.
